title: Vanilla Extras
description: A high-performance optimization modpack with Distant Horizons, dynamic lighting, and Xaero's maps for Fabric.
body:
# ⚡ Performance, Maps & Visuals Plus

Welcome to the ultimate modpack designed for players who want to squeeze every last drop of FPS out of their PC without sacrificing stunning visuals and quality-of-life features! Built on top of **Fabric**, this pack offers the perfect balance between beauty, high performance, and essential survival tools.

---

## 🔥 Key Features

### 🗺️ Navigation & Maps
*   **Xaero's World Map & Minimap:** A full-screen world map and a clean, customizable minimap in the corner of your screen. Easily navigate, set waypoints, and never lose your base or death location again.

### 🌅 Stunning Visuals & Lighting
*   **Distant Horizons:** Adds simplified chunk rendering (LODs), allowing you to see breathtaking, massive distances without any performance drops!
*   **LambDynamicLights:** Realistic dynamic lighting. Torches, glowstone, and other light-emitting items will illuminate the world around you while held in your hand or dropped on the ground.
*   **Iris Shaders:** Full shader support with flawless integration into Sodium.
*   **ETF & EMF (Entity Texture/Model Features):** Complete support for custom entity models and textures (Optifine features format).

### 🚀 Uncompromising Optimization
*   **Sodium & Lithium:** Drastically increase your framerate (FPS) and heavily reduce CPU overhead.
*   **Indium:** Provides full rendering API support for other block/item-modifying mods.
*   **VMP & Krypton:** Optimize network protocols for a smooth, lag-free experience on multiplayer servers.

### 🛠️ Quality of Life & UI
*   **JEI (Just Enough Items):** A clean and easy-to-use recipe viewer for all blocks and items.
*   **Reese's Sodium Options:** An expanded, cleaner, and much more intuitive video settings menu.
*   **Zoomify:** The best, highly customizable camera zoom mod for Fabric.

---

## 📌 Installation Notes
This modpack is fully ready for both singleplayer worlds and multiplayer servers. You can customize the minimap settings by pressing the **Y** key (default) in-game. Shaders can be enabled directly through the standard video settings menu.
